Quickstart

FetchKit is a tiny HTTP client for testing and debugging REST APIs from the command line and from scripts. This guide shows how to install it and make a request.

Install

pip install fetchkit
fetchkit --version

Send a request

import fetchkit

client = fetchkit.Client(base_url="https://api.example.com")
response = client.get("/users", params={"limit": 10})
print(response.json())

Responses are parsed automatically and errors raise descriptive exceptions, which makes debugging failing API calls straightforward.
